mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_staff_id, o.display_name AS owner_name, c.team_id, c.customer_no, c.display_name, c.nickname, c.mobile_cipher, c.city_code, c.customer_status, c.tier_code, c.intent_level, c.points_cached, c.last_followup_at, c.created_at, c.version, c.source_code, c.channel_code, c.spending_level, c.birthday, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ct.tag_code) FROM crm_customer_tag ct WHERE ct.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND ct.customer_id=c.id) AS tag_codes, (SELECT MAX(f.next_followup_at) FROM crm_followup f WHERE f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.customer_id=c.id AND f.deleted=0) AS next_followup_at FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND o.id = c.owner_staff_id
ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer (tenant_id, owner_staff_id, team_id, customer_no, display_name, nickname, remark_name, mobile_cipher, mobile_hash, city_code, source_code, channel_code, customer_status, tier_code, intent_level, spending_level, birthday, attention_projects, blocker_note, remark, first_added_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ownerStaffId}, #{teamId}, #{customerNo}, #{displayName}, #{nickname}, #{remarkName}, #{mobileCipher}, #{mobileHash}, #{cityCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{channelCode}, #{customerStatus}, #{tierCode}, #{intentLevel}, #{spendingLevel}, #{birthday}, #{attentionProjects}, #{blockerNote}, #{remark}, #{firstAddedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer SET customer_no = #{customerNo} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE crm_customer SET display_name = #{displayName}, nickname = #{nickname}, remark_name = #{remarkName}, mobile_cipher = #{mobileCipher}, mobile_hash = #{mobileHash}, city_code = #{cityCode}, source_code = #{sourceCode}, channel_code = #{channelCode}, customer_status = #{customerStatus}, tier_code = #{tierCode}, intent_level = #{intentLevel}, spending_level = #{spendingLevel}, birthday = #{birthday}, attention_projects = #{attentionProjects}, blocker_note = #{blockerNote}, remark = #{remark}, first_added_at = #{firstAddedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE crm_customer SET owner_staff_id = #{newOwnerId}, team_id = #{newTeamId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE crm_customer SET last_followup_at = #{lastFollowupAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (last_followup_at IS NULL OR last_followup_at < #{lastFollowupAt})
UPDATE crm_customer SET first_order_at = #{paidAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND first_order_at IS NULL
UPDATE crm_customer SET points_cached = #{newBalance} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE crm_customer SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT mobile_hash FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mobile_hash IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY mobile_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT id FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND deleted = 0

SELECT i.external_id FROM crm_customer_identity i INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND c.id = i.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY i.external_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) > 1

SELECT DISTINCT i.customer_id FROM crm_customer_identity i INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND c.id = i.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.external_id = #{externalId} ORDER BY i.customer_id ASC
